items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS edits FROM marts.fct_edits LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_creations FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE is_new_page LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS bot_edits FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE is_bot LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS anonymous_edits FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE is_anonymous LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wiki) AS wikis FROM marts.fct_edits LIMIT 1000
SELECT wiki, edits FROM marts.dim_wiki ORDER BY edits DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wiktionaries FROM marts.dim_wiki WHERE project_family = 'wiktionary' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS minor_edits FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE wiki = 'enwiki' AND is_minor LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS edits FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE event_ts >= '2026-10-17 00:00:00+00' AND event_ts < '2026-10-17 00:10:00+00' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pages FROM marts.dim_page WHERE edits >= 10 LIMIT 1000
SELECT edits FROM marts.agg_edits_hourly WHERE wiki = 'wikidatawiki' AND event_hour = '2026-10-17 00:00:00+00' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS editors FROM marts.agg_editor_activity WHERE wiki = 'commonswiki' LIMIT 1000
SELECT w.project_family, COUNT(*) AS edits FROM marts.fct_edits AS e JOIN marts.dim_wiki AS w ON w.wiki = e.wiki GROUP BY w.project_family LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_creations FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE wiki = 'dewiki' AND is_new_page LIMIT 1000
SELECT namespace_name, COUNT(*) AS edits FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE wiki = 'frwiktionary' GROUP BY namespace_name LIMIT 1000
SELECT is_bot, COUNT(*) AS edits FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE wiki = 'wikidatawiki' GROUP BY is_bot LIMIT 1000
SELECT wiki, COUNT(*) AS anonymous_edits FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE is_anonymous GROUP BY wiki ORDER BY anonymous_edits DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS article_creations FROM marts.dim_page AS p JOIN marts.dim_wiki AS w ON w.wiki = p.wiki WHERE w.project_family = 'wikipedia' AND p.namespace_name = 'Main' AND p.created_in_window LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(byte_delta) AS net_bytes FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE wiki = 'enwiki' AND namespace_name = 'Main' LIMIT 1000
SELECT -MIN(byte_delta) AS bytes_removed FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE wiki = 'enwiki' AND byte_delta < 0 LIMIT 1000
SELECT event_hour, SUM(bytes_added) AS bytes_added, SUM(bytes_removed) AS bytes_removed FROM marts.agg_edits_hourly GROUP BY event_hour LIMIT 1000
SELECT w.project_family, COUNT(*) AS edits FROM marts.fct_edits AS e JOIN marts.dim_wiki AS w ON w.wiki = e.wiki WHERE w.language_code = 'ja' GROUP BY w.project_family LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS draft_pages FROM marts.dim_page WHERE wiki = 'enwiki' AND namespace_name = 'Draft' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS editors FROM marts.agg_editor_activity WHERE wiki = 'wikidatawiki' AND edits > 100 LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pages FROM marts.dim_page WHERE wiki = 'enwiki' AND created_in_window AND distinct_editors > 1 LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wikis FROM marts.dim_wiki WHERE project_family = 'wikipedia' AND edits >= 100 LIMIT 1000
SELECT w.project_family, COUNT(*) AS edits FROM marts.fct_edits AS e JOIN marts.dim_wiki AS w ON w.wiki = e.wiki WHERE w.language_code = 'en' GROUP BY w.project_family LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS talk_edits FROM marts.fct_edits AS e JOIN marts.dim_wiki AS w ON w.wiki = e.wiki WHERE w.project_family = 'wikipedia' AND e.namespace % 2 = 1 LIMIT 1000
SELECT event_hour, COUNT(*) AS edits FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE wiki = 'enwiki' AND NOT is_bot AND NOT is_anonymous GROUP BY event_hour LIMIT 1000
SELECT wiki, COUNT(*) AS anonymous_editors FROM marts.agg_editor_activity WHERE is_anonymous GROUP BY wiki ORDER BY anonymous_editors DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT e.wiki, COUNT(*) AS page_creations FROM marts.fct_edits AS e JOIN marts.dim_wiki AS w ON w.wiki = e.wiki WHERE w.project_family = 'wiktionary' AND e.is_new_page GROUP BY e.wiki ORDER BY page_creations DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wikis FROM marts.dim_wiki WHERE edits = 0 LIMIT 1000

SELECT w.project_family, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.is_bot) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS bot_pct FROM marts.fct_edits AS e JOIN marts.dim_wiki AS w ON w.wiki = e.wiki GROUP BY w.project_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 LIMIT 1000
SELECT wiki, event_hour, edits FROM marts.agg_edits_hourly ORDER BY edits DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS editors FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE wiki = 'enwiki' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS editors FROM marts.fct_edits WHERE event_hour = '2026-10-17 00:00:00+00' LIMIT 1000

SELECT project_family, wiki, edits FROM (SELECT project_family, wiki, edits, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY project_family ORDER BY edits DESC) AS rnk, SUM(edits) OVER (PARTITION BY project_family) AS family_edits FROM marts.dim_wiki WHERE project_family IS NOT NULL) AS ranked WHERE rnk = 1 AND family_edits >= 50 LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS editors FROM (SELECT user_name FROM marts.agg_editor_activity GROUP BY user_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) AS multi LIMIT 1000
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', event_ts) AS minute, COUNT(*) AS edits FROM marts.fct_edits GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY edits DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT h.wiki, SUM(h.edits) FILTER(WHERE h.event_hour = '2026-10-16 23:00:00+00') AS edits_2300, SUM(h.edits) FILTER(WHERE h.event_hour = '2026-10-17 00:00:00+00') AS edits_0000 FROM marts.agg_edits_hourly AS h JOIN marts.dim_wiki AS w ON w.wiki = h.wiki WHERE w.edits >= 50 GROUP BY h.wiki HAVING COALESCE(SUM(h.edits) FILTER(WHERE h.event_hour = '2026-10-16 23:00:00+00'), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(h.edits) FILTER(WHERE h.event_hour = '2026-10-17 00:00:00+00'), 0) LIMIT 1000
